baseline_models.focus_anchor: The road noun, the relative phrase identifying its people, the active benefaction, and the two contrasted groups jointly anchor the model.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse does not identify a road by geometry alone. It makes bestowed well-being visible in a recipient group, so their lived trajectory becomes the road's positive continuity; opposition and deviation are rival ways of leaving that continuity.

activation_trace.role: The straight-road image supplies continuous movement, while the following relative phrase relocates that continuity into an embodied human route.
Bestowed favorable condition supplies the observable state by which the road-bearing group is identified.
Otherness and exception turn the verse from a single route description into a contrast among trajectories.
Defiance and opposition supply a relational mechanism for one trajectory's rupture rather than merely naming an emotion.
Deviation from aim supplies the second failure mode: motion continues but no longer holds the road's direction.

changed_reading.before: The verse names a road used by a favored class and excludes two bad classes.
changed_reading.after: The verse makes a favored human trajectory the road's visible embodiment and distinguishes oppositional rupture from aimless deviation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The road, favor, wrath, and straying roots all carry material branches that can be coordinated around passage, softness, hardness, and disappearance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two kinds of disappearance coexist. A soft, capacious passage can carry a traveler through so completely that the traveler vanishes into successful transit, whereas straying can also make something vanish but without destination or recoverability. Compact hardness acts as the obstructing condition that separates the two.

activation_trace.role: Disappearance through swallowing supplies a successful passage in which being taken out of sight is evidence of transit.
Softness and easeful living supply low resistance, making the favored passage traversable rather than abrasive.
Hard compact rock supplies the blocking material state opposed to softened passage.
Hiddenness and disappearance supply a failed vanishing that lacks the road's directed transit.

changed_reading.before: Road and straying are simple opposites: presence on the route versus absence from it.
changed_reading.after: Both right passage and straying can involve disappearance; the decisive difference is whether disappearance completes directed transit or erases recoverable direction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The road's cutting branch, the exception term's legal-alternative branch, wrath's retaliation branch, and straying's loss branch remain attached to the verse's three-way partition.
baseline_models.mechanism: The road can image a decisive cut that separates outcomes. The exception pivot opens an alternative to retaliatory settlement, while the final group represents what never reaches settlement because it has gone unaccounted for.

activation_trace.role: A cutting implement passing cleanly through a stroke supplies the road as a decisive separator of outcomes.
Compensation offered instead of retaliation supplies a legal fork at the verse's exception pivot.
Anger rising toward retaliation supplies the threatened punitive settlement on one side of the fork.
A lost and unlocated thing supplies the unresolved outcome that falls outside both favorable passage and settled retaliation.

changed_reading.before: The final contrasts are descriptive labels attached to people.
changed_reading.after: The verse can stage a decisive partition among favorable passage, retaliatory exposure, and an unresolved loss that never arrives for settlement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active second-person benefaction, passive angered construction, active-participial straying, and the branches of furthering, opposition, and deviation anchor an agency-sensitive reading.
baseline_models.mechanism: The three groups differ not only in outcome but in causal grammar. Favor actively carries recipients further; the angered group bears a condition produced in a relation of opposition; the strayers enact continuing deviation. The road is therefore a pattern of agency distribution.

activation_trace.role: Adding and carrying an action further supplies active propulsion to the explicitly second-person benefaction.
Mutual opposition supplies the relation whose result is borne by the passive angered group.
Deviation from aim supplies ongoing self-propelled divergence to the active-participial final group.
Replacement and change of state make the exception pivot a switch among causal regimes rather than a flat list boundary.

changed_reading.before: All three groups are parallel moral categories.
changed_reading.after: They encode different causal positions: actively furthered recipients, people bearing relational opposition, and agents continuing to deviate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening designation cue, including its non-dominant visible-mark mapping, turns the road into something recognized by signs. The favored group's condition can function as a trail mark rather than merely as a credential possessed before travel.

activation_trace.role: Designation and indication supply the act of making a route or its bearer identifiable.
A visible identifying mark supplies the concrete sign by which the favored trajectory can be followed.
The road supplies the spatial carrier on which identifying marks accumulate.
Bestowed well-being supplies the visible human effect that can serve as a route marker.

structural_cues: The context begins with designation, while the focus identifies the road through a relative clause naming its bearers rather than through coordinates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies designation, visible marking, road, and bestowed condition; I infer that bestowed condition marks the traversable route; a live alternative is that the opening designation merely authorizes speech and contributes no wayfinding function.

changed_reading.before: The road is known chiefly by where it leads.
changed_reading.after: The road is also known by legible effects borne by favored travelers, who function as its identifying marks.

context_deltas.mechanism: Worship relation, tenderness, and kinship recast the favored plural as an affiliation generated by mercy. The road becomes entry into and continuity within a relational household, not imitation of isolated exemplary individuals.

activation_trace.role: The worshipper-worshipped relation supplies the vertical bond around which the favored affiliation coheres.
Tender mercy supplies the affective force that forms rather than merely rewards the group.
Kinship supplies a lateral bond among recipients, making their shared road a relation of belonging.
Benefaction given to another supplies the transfer that creates and sustains the affiliation.
The road supplies continuity through which the mercy-formed affiliation persists.

structural_cues: The focus uses a plural relative group and repeats the plural relational pronoun around both favor and anger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies worship relation, tenderness, kinship, and transferred favor; I infer that these bonds constitute a road-bearing affiliation; a live alternative is that kinship is only an etymological shadow and the group remains a set of unrelated exemplars.

changed_reading.before: Those favored are separate precedents whom a traveler should copy.
changed_reading.after: Those favored can be a mercy-formed affiliation into which the requested road incorporates the traveler.

context_deltas.mechanism: Praiseworthy end, repairful upbringing, nourished growth, and orienting marks combine into a developmental process. Favor no longer appears only as a prior gift qualifying certain people; it is the sustained cultivation that carries them further toward completion and leaves signs others can follow.

activation_trace.role: The praiseworthy end supplies a telos toward which the road's cultivation is directed.
Repair, upbringing, and completion supply the staged process that produces favored travelers.
The non-dominant nourishment-and-growth image supplies the material rate of development within that process.
A distinguishing trace that guides supplies feedback marks by which developing travelers stay oriented.
Adding and carrying further supplies continuing advancement rather than a completed one-time grant.
The road supplies ordered succession to the stages of cultivation.

structural_cues: Praise, lordly relation, and worlds occur as a sequence before the later petition and its specification by favored people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a praiseworthy end, upbringing to completion, growth, orienting marks, and furthering; I infer a feedback-guided developmental arrow among them; a live alternative is that each cue names a static divine attribute with no process relation.

changed_reading.before: Favor is a possession already held by the people who define the road.
changed_reading.after: Favor is an ongoing curriculum of repair, nourishment, marked progress, and completion that produces the road-bearing people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated tenderness cue gives mercy greater textual persistence than wrath. Wrath can therefore be read as a boundary response to opposition inside a mercy-dominant field, not as an equal and independent destination paired symmetrically with favor.

activation_trace.role: Tender mercy establishes the first affective field in which the later contrast will be heard.
The repeated tenderness image supplies persistence and makes mercy the enclosing rather than incidental condition.
Opposition supplies the relational breach to which bounded wrath responds.
Transferred benefaction supplies mercy's positive operation in the focus rather than leaving mercy as context-only atmosphere.

structural_cues: The paired mercy descriptors recur before the single passive angered expression.
The favor clause names its second-person agent, whereas the angered construction leaves its agent unexpressed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated tenderness, one passive wrath construction, and opposition; I infer that repetition and agency asymmetry bound wrath within mercy's field; a live alternative is that repetition has no governing force over the focus contrast.

changed_reading.before: Favor and wrath are two symmetrical divine dispositions assigning opposite groups.
changed_reading.after: Mercy is the persistent field of the route, while wrath is a bounded relational response marking resistance within that field.

context_deltas.mechanism: Disposition, bounded time, and reckoning turn the focus partition into an accountable process. The road cuts among outcomes that eventually become settleable: benefaction carries forward, opposition incurs a retaliatory claim, and straying remains a loss until located and accounted for.

activation_trace.role: Ownership with power of disposition supplies authority to settle the divergent trajectories.
A bounded day supplies the horizon at which open trajectories become due for resolution.
Reckoning and recompense supply the settlement operation applied at that horizon.
The clean cutting stroke supplies decisive partition among accountable outcomes.
Compensation as an alternative to retaliation supplies a possible legal fork rather than a purely emotional contrast.
Retaliatory anger supplies the claim incurred by one opposed trajectory.
An unlocated loss supplies the trajectory that has not arrived for settlement.

structural_cues: The context compresses authority, a time horizon, and reckoning into one construct chain before the first-person commitment and request.
The focus then presents one positive and two negative trajectories in a tightly coordinated sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disposition, bounded time, reckoning, a cutting route, compensation, retaliation, and loss; I infer a settlement arrow from travel to accountable outcome; a live alternative is that the legal images only intensify contrast without forming a procedural sequence.

changed_reading.before: The focus lists spiritually approved and disapproved populations.
changed_reading.after: The focus can map trajectories by their status in an eventual settlement: advanced by favor, exposed to retaliatory claim, or still lost from account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humble service levels a way, walking places it underfoot, and requested assistance supplies the capacity to continue. The road is therefore partly enacted by repeated service rather than merely discovered as external geography.

activation_trace.role: Humble worship supplies the repeated practice through which travelers submit their motion to the route.
Leveling and making tractable supply the road-making effect of that repeated practice.
Assistance and reinforcement supply power that the travelers do not generate alone.
Going on foot supplies bodily contact through which the road is progressively worn and known.
The road supplies the durable result and constraint of service, walking, and assistance.

structural_cues: First-person plural service and help-seeking immediately precede the plural guidance petition and the road specification.
The same speaking group acts, asks for capacity, and then asks to be placed in a prior group's trajectory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies worship, leveling, aid, foot travel, and road; I infer that assisted practice both traverses and makes the route; a live alternative is that worship only qualifies the petitioner and does not alter the road's material or social availability.

changed_reading.before: The road exists complete before the traveler and needs only to be pointed out.
changed_reading.after: The road is received but also enacted underfoot: humble practice levels it, communal walking preserves it, and aid keeps the enactment possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gentle indication initiates movement, the repeated road noun carries the request across the ayah boundary, and upright balance gives the route a regulating form. The focus is thus not an independent taxonomy but the operational specification of what the requested straight road looks like in people and in failure.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies the initiating guidance operation.
The first road occurrence opens a syntactic trajectory that the focus repeats and specifies.
Uprightness, balance, and evenness supply the regulating shape requested of the route.
The repeated road converts the focus into a concrete continuation and specification of the petition.
Bestowed well-being supplies the positive human diagnostic of upright guidance.
Deviation from aim supplies the diagnostic failure of the regulating guidance.

structural_cues: The road noun repeats across 1:6 and 1:7.
An adjective of straightness is followed by a relative-clause specification through people and then two coordinated failure groups.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gentle indication, repeated road, upright balance, favored condition, and deviation; I infer that 1:7 functions as a diagnostic answer to 1:6; a live alternative is that 1:7 merely appends historical examples without specifying the mechanism of straightness.

changed_reading.before: The focus independently divides people into three classes.
changed_reading.after: The focus answers the guidance request by translating straightness into a favored human trajectory and two distinct diagnostic failures.

context_deltas.mechanism: The gift-bearing branch of guidance resonates with active benefaction in the focus. Guidance can therefore be received as something sent through affection, while favored people are not only earlier users of the road but carriers through whom the gift reaches later petitioners.

activation_trace.role: A gift dispatched gently to one held in affection supplies transmissible guidance rather than bare directional information.
Benefaction delivered to another supplies the reception side of the transmitted gift.
Carrying an action further supplies onward transmission beyond the first recipients.
The road supplies the durable channel along which the guidance-gift is passed.

structural_cues: The guidance imperative addresses the same second-person agent who is named as active benefactor in the focus.
The requested object is specified through prior recipients rather than by an abstract definition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guidance-as-gift, transferred benefaction, furthering, and a recipient-defined road; I infer onward transmission through favored people; a live alternative is that gift imagery concerns only the divine-to-petitioner relation and does not make recipients into carriers.

changed_reading.before: Favored people prove that guidance was given in the past.
changed_reading.after: Favored people can be living relays through whom the guidance-gift is carried further to new petitioners.

context_deltas.mechanism: Community, custodial care, and material support turn straightness from an individual posture into maintained infrastructure. The favored collective bears, repairs, and supplies the route, so belonging to their road entails participation in its upkeep.

activation_trace.role: A community of people supplies the collective body in which straightness is realized.
Care, preservation, and guardianship supply ongoing maintenance of the route.
Support and livelihood supply the material infrastructure that keeps communal travel viable.
The road supplies the shared artifact preserved by collective care.
Bestowed welfare supplies both the community's condition and the resources it can transmit.

structural_cues: The petition is first-person plural, and the focus specifies the route by another plural group.
Straightness modifies the road before the focus replaces geometric description with collective biography.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies community, custodial care, support, road, and shared welfare; I infer that the group maintains the road as infrastructure; a live alternative is that the plural groups remain aggregates of individuals with no maintenance relation.

changed_reading.before: Straightness is an individual traveler's correct alignment on a fixed road.
changed_reading.after: Straightness is also a communal achievement: favored people keep the shared route standing, supplied, and available.

context_deltas.mechanism: Increase and equal measure form a dynamic control system. Favor propels growth beyond the current state, while straightness continually corrects that growth toward proportion; deviation is not lack of motion but growth that has lost feedback.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant increase-and-rising image supplies expansion rather than static possession.
Equal weight and measured proportion supply corrective calibration for that expansion.
Adding and going further supply the focus-level propulsion that makes calibration necessary.
Deviation from aim supplies the failure mode of expansion no longer corrected by measure.

structural_cues: A growth-bearing lordly cue occurs early, measured straightness immediately precedes the focus, and active benefaction in the focus distinguishes the road-bearing group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies increase, equal measure, furthering, and deviation; I infer a feedback arrow in which measure regulates growth; a live alternative is that increase and measure are unrelated branch images and straightness means only fixed conformity.

changed_reading.before: Straightness means preserving an unchanged mean and avoiding all departure from it.
changed_reading.after: Straightness can be regulated growth: favor drives further development, while measure repeatedly corrects its direction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it coordinates branch-distant rain, spring, wind, swallowing, watering, and rock images across several roots. It remains anchored in the focus road, benefaction, exception, wrath, and disappearance branches, with context supplying actual water-system images. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for directed provision versus blocked or lost flow, never as a lexical replacement for the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus road can carry flow, benefaction can bring a moist wind, the exception root can water and repair, wrath can harden as rock, and straying can disappear from sight.

activation_trace.role: Swallowing passage supplies a channel that receives and carries flow out of sight.
A soft moist wind supplies mobile provision to the favored terrain.
Watering, provisioning, and repair supply the ecological transformation associated with right flow.
Hard compact rock supplies the substrate that blocks absorption or redirects flow.
Disappearance supplies water lost underground or out of the directed channel.
First rain marking earth with vegetation supplies visible evidence that provision reached its course.
Water as the matter's controlling support supplies the system's indispensable medium.
The non-dominant spring image supplies a replenishing source for the route-channel.

changed_reading.before: The road is a dry surface carrying human travelers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can behave like a watercourse: favor replenishes and repairs along directed flow, hardness blocks it, and straying is flow that disappears without fructifying the marked terrain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a womb image is mapped onto a road and coordinated with swallowing passage, softness, compact obstruction, and hiddenness. It remains anchored through focus branches governing passage and its success or failure, while the context supplies the generative enclosure. Downstream prose should label it a gestational spatial analogy, not claim that the road noun means birth canal.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus itself juxtaposes a swallowing passage, softened benefaction, compact hardness, and two distinct forms of disappearance.

activation_trace.role: The womb supplies a protected enclosure whose hidden transit is ordered toward emergence.
Swallowing passage supplies movement through an enclosing interior rather than over an exposed surface.
Softness and ease supply the yielding conditions of successful protected transit.
Compact rock supplies failed dilation or a hardened obstruction to emergence.
Hidden disappearance supplies enclosure without emergence, distinguishing loss from gestation.

changed_reading.before: Successful travel should remain visible as continuous progress on an open road.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the favored route can include a hidden gestational interval in which disappearance is protected formation, while straying is hiddenness that does not emerge into directed life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the trigger comes from the non-dominant eye mapping of the help root and then recruits eye-related focus branches. It remains anchored in benefaction's gladdened eye, wrath's swollen eye, and straying's hiddenness, all attached to focus words. Downstream prose should explicitly call this a split-root visual activation and avoid translating help as eye.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Three focus roots support states of the eye or visibility: gladdening, swelling, and disappearance.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant watchful eye of care supplies assistance as being kept under protective observation.
Direct seeing supplies the visibility relation by which trajectories become inspectable.
The gladdened eye supplies favor as restored or delighted vision.
Swelling around the eye supplies wrath as impaired or burdened vision.
Hiddenness supplies the terminal visual failure in which the route or traveler drops from view.
A visible sign disclosing condition supplies what the watchful gaze reads along the route.

changed_reading.before: The three groups differ only by where they travel.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they also differ as visual relations: cared-for and gladdened sight, sight burdened by swelling, and disappearance beyond recoverable view.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant demolition mapping of guidance together with the road's sword and wrath's rock. It remains anchored in the focus's cutting-road and hardened-wrath branches, while contextual standing supplies a coherent material counteraction. Downstream prose should render it as an ordeal-and-resilience image, not as the ordinary sense of guidance or road.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus can image the road as a passing cut, wrath as compact rock, and straying as loss of aim.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant demolition image supplies a force that breaks unstable or obstructing structures.
A cutting stroke supplies the road as an ordeal that passes through what it tests.
Compact rock supplies hardened resistance exposed to the breaking and cutting force.
Bodily standing supplies the resilient result of alignment under the ordeal.
Loss of aim supplies collapse without a stable line of resistance or recovery.

changed_reading.before: Guidance gently avoids every disruptive force.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, guidance can include a breaking test: the route cuts through hardened obstruction, and straightness is the capacity to remain or rise standing through it.

strongest_changes: The focus shifted from a taxonomy of groups to a humanly embodied route with distinct causal failure modes.
The 1:2 cues turned benefaction from a prior possession into feedback-guided cultivation toward completion.
The 1:4 cues made the focus partition procedurally accountable rather than merely affective.
The 1:5 cues made the road an assisted practice enacted and maintained underfoot.
The repeated road in 1:6 made 1:7 the operational specification of requested straightness.
summary.what_was_special: Split mappings materially changed the trace instead of being collapsed: visible marking made the route legible, increase made straightness dynamic, watchful care made the groups visual states, and demolition generated a contained fracture-and-standing model. These coexist with mercy-affiliation, judicial, developmental, gift-transmission, and communal-infrastructure readings rather than resolving into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The agency gradient is grammatically visible, but the exact causal force of the passive angered construction remains underdetermined.
The claim that repeated mercy bounds wrath depends on treating repetition and agency asymmetry as governing signals rather than local emphasis.
The legal-compensation, hydrological, ocular, gestational, and demolition activations are coherent mechanisms but remain branch-distant analogies.
The favored collective may mark, transmit, maintain, or simply exemplify the road; the packet keeps all four relations live.
